project: Consolidate CLI Factory Save and Update From-File Commands
description: Extract one shared internal implementation in pkg/cli/factory for file-based named-factory persistence used by you factory save --from and you factory update --from, preserving all CLI flags, exit codes, stdout/stderr text, JSON field names, and mode-specific persist and error behavior.

context.customerAsk: Consolidate duplicated file-based persist flow between SaveFromFile and UpdateFromFile in pkg/cli/factory without changing CLI flags, exit codes, stdout/stderr text, or JSON field names.
context.problem: save.go and update.go duplicate validation, payload read, canonical JSON load, persist call, and overlapping error mapping. Only PersistNamedFactory vs ReplaceNamedFactory, optional SetCurrent on save, success message text, and update-specific factory-not-found mapping differ—creating drift risk when one path is fixed but not the other.
context.solution: Add a shared persist-from-file helper with save|update mode and unified error rendering; refactor SaveFromFile and UpdateFromFile into thin wrappers; lock behavior with existing pkg/cli/factory tests.

acceptanceCriteria: go test ./pkg/cli/factory/... passes with no intentional behavior changes to offline save or update
you factory save --from preserves create, duplicate rejection, invalid-config handling, --set-current pointer behavior, and human/JSON output
you factory update --from preserves replace, factory-not-found handling, invalid-config handling, and human/JSON output
CLI flags, command names, exit codes, stdout/stderr wording, and JSON field names remain unchanged
Shared internal helper in pkg/cli/factory owns validation, load, persist, optional pointer write, and mode-aware errors; SaveFromFile and UpdateFromFile are thin delegators
No HTTP/API, config/persist semantic, or clihttp submit migration changes
Typecheck, lint, and project tests pass

userStories.title: Shared from-file persistence core for save mode
userStories.description: As an operator running you factory save --from, I want the same create, validation, pointer, and output behavior after consolidation so existing scripts and docs stay valid.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared internal helper in pkg/cli/factory performs input validation, payload read, LoadFromCanonicalJSON, PersistNamedFactory, and optional WriteCurrentFactoryPointer when SetCurrent is true in save mode
SaveFromFile delegates to the shared helper and still prints Saved factory <name> and Directory: <dir> for human output
--json save output still encodes name and factoryDir with unchanged JSON field names
Save still returns factory already exists for duplicates and invalid factory config for bad payloads/topology without creating a named directory on topology failure
All TestSaveFromFile_* tests pass without relaxed assertions
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Update command uses the same shared core in update mode
userStories.description: As an operator running you factory update --from, I want replace semantics and messaging unchanged so in-place factory upgrades remain predictable.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared helper update mode calls ReplaceNamedFactory and does not write the current-factory pointer
UpdateFromFile delegates to the shared helper and still prints Updated factory <name> and Directory: <dir> for human output
--json update output still encodes name and factoryDir with unchanged JSON field names
Update still returns factory not found for missing factories and invalid factory config for bad payloads; invalid topology update preserves prior on-disk factory body
All TestUpdateFromFile_* tests pass without relaxed assertions
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Unified mode-aware error rendering
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one error-mapping path for from-file persistence so save and update stay aligned on invalid-config handling while keeping mode-specific duplicate and not-found wording.
acceptanceCriteria: One internal error renderer maps save duplicate to factory already exists, update missing factory to factory not found, and both invalid named-factory cases to invalid factory config
Uncovered errors such as read factory config failures pass through with the same wording as today
TestSaveFromFile_RejectsDuplicateName, TestUpdateFromFile_RejectsMissingName, and invalid-payload tests for both commands still pass with the same error substrings
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Thin public wrappers and duplication removed

Exported SaveFromFileConfig, SaveFromFileResult, UpdateFromFileConfig, and UpdateFromFileResult types and JSON tags are unchanged
pkg/cli/root.go still wires factory save and factory update through SaveFromFile and UpdateFromFile without flag or help text changes
go test ./pkg/cli/factory/... passes
